statement:
∀ (θ φ θ' φ' : ℝ),
  ↑(3 / (4 * π)) * (↑(cos θ) * ↑(cos θ')) +
      ↑(3 / (8 * π)) * (↑(sin θ) * ↑(sin θ')) *
        (Complex.exp ((↑φ - ↑φ') * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-((↑φ - ↑φ') * Complex.I))) =
    ↑(3 / (4 * π) * (cos θ * cos θ' + sin θ * sin θ' * cos (φ - φ')))
